title: Fal Raises $1.65B in Funding to Value AI Startup at $16B
summary:
The San Francisco-based AI startup secured new capital through its most recent Series E and F investment rounds to expand its cloud compute capabilities. Led by Bessemer Venture Partners and Sequoia, the combined $1.65B raise includes participation from Nvidia and brings the company's valuation to $16B, double the $8B value it held in April.

Founded in 2021 by former Amazon and Coinbase engineers, Fal provides the backend infrastructure for developers and studios to generate AI images, video and audio. The company has scaled to approximately 150 employees and reportedly hit $800M in annualized revenue this year, with high-volume professional clients spending up to $20K per month on the platform.

selectedTweets.text:
BREAKING: @fal just raised $1.65 BILLION across its Series E & F

› Series E led by @sequoia
› Series F led by @BessemerVP

I sat down w/ Co-Founders: CEO Burkay Gür (@burkaygur) & CTO Görkem Yurtseven (@gorkem) to discuss the explosive growth of generative media, which they believe is 1 of only 3 major product-market fits in AI, alongside search & coding agents.

Founded in 2021 by former Coinbase & Amazon engineers, fal powers the infrastructure behind AI image, video, audio & 3D models, serving developers, studios & model labs.

fal
/faɫ/ · noun · Turkish
Pronounced approximately “fahl” (rhymes with doll in many American accents)

Definitions
1. Fortune-telling; divination. The practice of predicting future events, particularly through interpreting coffee grounds, cards, or other symbols.

2. Fortune; fate; luck. A person's destiny or prospects.

3. Omen; augury. A sign interpreted as indicating what may happen in the future.

A few highlights:
›› Professional users spend $10K–$20K/month generating AI media.
›› Video reached ~70% of fal's revenue before image editing drove a resurgence, bringing the mix back to 50/50.
›› Demand continued growing even as premium AI video model prices jumped more than 10X.
›› fal has scaled to ~150 employees with just 2 reporting levels.
›› Compute shortages are shaping model launches, while the founders believe AI's strongest margins will be captured by infrastructure providers rather than applications.

"AI really has 3 product market fits. One of them is search. The other really clear one that's growing really fast now is coding agents. & the third one is, we believe, generative media."

We recorded at Dalida in San Francisco & got into fal's evolution from Python infrastructure, the economics of AI inference, Hollywood, robotics, world models & the future of compute.

This was SO much fun!!
